snippet.title: Timebound Announcement Trailer
snippet.description:
Wishlist & Play now - https://store.steampowered.com/app/3220700/Timebound/
Come say hi! - https://discord.gg/KvUbSJtk5U

Timebound is a rule-discovery puzzle adventure in mystical ruins. Explore the open world, discover what's hidden in plain sight, learn the rules and break them.

Lead: Michał Kluz michal@kluz.net
Art: Patrycja Sagan https://www.artstation.com/patrycjasagan1
Music & Sound: Fabien Calabria https://www.fabiencalabria.fr/
